strings.예, 그럭저럭요. 할 말이 있다고 해서 왔는데, 지금은 기억나나요?: Well enough. You said you had something to tell me. Do you remember now?
strings.마치 내가 술 때문에 기억하지 못했다, 그런 느낌의 말투인데? 뭐, 상관: You make it sound like I forgot because of the drink. Well, whatever...
strings.네가 마법학원 제레니스의 일을 해결하고 오는 동안, 이곳에 널 찾아온 사: While you were sorting out the trouble at Xerenis Magic Academy, someone came looking for you.
strings.짧은 머리에 안경을 쓴 모습이 인상적이었지. 지엔디아나 이스트랜드 쪽 출: Short hair and glasses. Quite memorable. Looked like she came from Jiendia or Eastland.
strings.평범한 듯한 모습으로 이곳을 찾아왔지만, 굉장한 힘을 숨기고 있는 실력자: She looked ordinary, but we could sense she was highly skilled and concealing tremendous strength. Everyone was wary.
But the strength carried in her gentle voice made everyone trust her.
strings.유란…이군요. 이스트랜드의 빛의 연합 맹주인 검신 지스카드 님의 첫째 제: Yuran... Ziskad's first disciple. He's the Sword Master and leader of Eastland's Alliance of Light.
strings.검신이라 불리는 사람의 제자라면 역시 보통 사람이 아니겠군. 하여튼, 아: A disciple of someone called the Sword Master would be no ordinary person. Anyway, Einst told me you'd arrived, so I gave her your whereabouts.
strings.(어쩌면 이것도 폐하께서 알고 계셨던 게 아닐지….): (Perhaps Her Majesty knew this would happen, too...)
strings.그건 그렇고 네 행방을 알려준 것에 대해 불만은 없겠지?: You don't mind that I told her where you were, do you?
strings.딱히 불만은 없어요. 어차피 개인정보란 건 어느 순간 공공재가 되어버리는: Not really. Personal information seems to become public property sooner or later in this world.
strings.무슨 소리를 하는지 모르겠네. 하여튼, 그 여자가 네가 돌아오면 자신에게: I don't know what you're talking about. Anyway, she asked you to visit when you returned...
Thank you, Lena. I'll go. Don't drink too much.
All right. But don't be late when it's time to receive the decree.
What's wrong? I heard you went all the way to the Guild Alliance...
First, I owe you an apology. Truthfully, I didn't want to seek you out.
strings.제가 해결하려고 했지만, 아무래도 스승님께서 말씀하셔서 어쩔 수 없었습니: I intended to handle this myself, but my master instructed otherwise.
strings.전 괜찮아요. 그런데, 지스카드 님이 어떤 말씀을 하셨나요?: It's all right. What did Ziskad say?
strings.울에 대한 이야기입니다. 울은 스승님의 제자 중 제일 어리지만, 제일 재: It's about Ull. He's the youngest of my master's disciples, and the most talented.
strings.재능이 있다 해도 소홀히 하는 법이 없고, 매일 같이 수련을 거듭하는 성: Despite his talent, he never neglects his training. He works diligently every day.
strings.자신감이 자만감으로 변하는 건 한 순간입니다. 그래서 그러지 말라 스승님: Confidence can become arrogance in an instant. My master and I warn him of that, but he doesn't seem to listen.
strings.지금 울은 상당히 위험한 상태입니다. 스승님께서도 저도 울에게서 '그'의: He's in considerable danger now. My master and I have both seen 'him' reflected in Ull.
I'll tell you. His name is Baral...
strings.제가 스승님의 첫 번째 제자라고 알려졌지만, 저보다 이전에 계셨던 분입니: I'm known as the first disciple, but he came before me.
strings.바랄은 울처럼 재능이 있는 데다가 수련을 게을리 하지 않는 훌륭한 제자였: Like Ull, Baral was a fine disciple, talented and tireless in his training.
strings.그의 능력이 뛰어났지만, 데이모스 교단과의 전투에서 모두를 지킬 수는 없: But despite his ability, he couldn't protect everyone in a battle against the Deimos cult.
strings.그 순간, 그는 자신의 실력이 부족하다 느끼고 좀 더 힘에 집착하기 시작: He felt his strength was lacking and became obsessed with gaining more. The sword he'd taken up to protect others began to change.
strings.스승님께서 그에게 힘에 집착하는 모습을 버리라 일렀지만, 그는 듣지 않았: My master told him to abandon that obsession, but he wouldn't listen.
strings.그러다 출입을 막았던 지스크 영지 입구에서 일이 벌어졌습니다…. 스승님의: Then something happened at the forbidden entrance to the Zisk Territory... The combat guild members tried to stop him on my master's orders, and he...
strings.이런 이야기를 꺼낸다는 게 참으로 송구하네요. %s 님께서 울을 설득해주: I'm sorry to bring up such a story. Please persuade Ull, %s.
My master asks it as well. He trusts you completely...
I'm not skilled enough to match Ull. How can I...?
strings.울은 지금 이리스 님의 일을 하는 %s 님의 이야기를 귀를 기울일지도 모: He may listen to you, %s, since you're working for Lady Iris. You wield strength too, but toward a different purpose...
strings.그렇게 말씀하신다면 울에게 가볼게요. 그런데, 울은 안 보이네요? 어디: If you say so, I'll talk to him. But I don't see him here. Where is he?
I heard he went to the Amaloon Desert to train.
strings.알았어요. 그럼 최대한 빨리 찾아서 설득해볼게요. 지스카드 님과 유란 님: I'll find him and try to persuade him quickly. Tell him you and Ziskad are worried.
strings.(유란이 고개를 숙여 이번 일을 부탁한다.): (Yuran bows her head in earnest request.)
Don't worry too much. I'll be back.
strings.별의 움직임이 조금 다른 것 같은 느낌이 들었는데, 그게 모험가님이셨군요: I felt a slight change in the stars' movements. It was you, adventurer.
strings.미안해요, 티야. 길게 이야기하고 싶은데, 지금 좀 바빠서 바로 가봐야: Sorry, Tia. I'd like to talk longer, but I'm busy and need to hurry.
strings.혹시 이렇게 생긴 사람 봤나요? 키는 요만하고, 머리는 요래서 좀 건방지: Have you seen someone like this? About this tall, hair like this... A rather cheeky-looking boy.
strings.(손짓과 몸짓으로 간단하게 울에 대해서 설명한다.): (You describe Ull with a few gestures.)
strings.아, 한 사람이 안식의 홀로 가는 걸 봤어요. 제가 위험한 곳이라고 들어: Oh, I saw someone entering the Hall of Rest. I warned him it was dangerous, but he went in anyway.
His expression and manner seemed a little strange.
I could only wait for him to return. Then you arrived.
strings.안식의 홀, 지금 그곳의 상태는 어떤가요?: What's the Hall of Rest like now?
strings.그곳에 들어가시게요? 아직도 죽은 자의 신, 그 불길한 힘이 미세하게 남: You're going inside? A faint trace of the god of the dead's sinister power remains.
Someone asked me to find him. I have to go.
strings.그러면 잠시만 제 곁으로 오시겠어요?: Then come close for a moment.
strings.(티야가 %s의 두 손을 잡는다. 잠시 후, 티야의 입에서 다른 세계의: (Tia takes %s's hands. Soon she speaks words that sound as though they belong to another world.)
Yes. An ancient language of our world. I don't know it in detail myself...
My mother used to say those words when praying to keep misfortune away.
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 울의 흔적을 찾긴 했지만, 벌써 나간 것 같더군요. 혹시: I'm fine. I found traces of Ull, but he'd already left. Did you see him?
strings.네, 안식의 홀 쪽에서 나오시는 그분을 봤어요. 잠깐 기다려달라고 붙잡았: Yes. He came out of the Hall of Rest. I tried to ask him to wait, but he shook me off.
strings.멈출 수 없어, 더 해야 해, 모자라…, 이런 이야기들 뿐이었어요. 그: Only, 'Can't stop. Must do more. Not enough...' He looked just like...
strings.힘을 갈구하는 표정이었어요. 힘을 원해서 집착하려고 하는…. 그때도 그랬: He looked desperate for power. Almost obsessed... My younger sibling had that same expression when making a pact with the god of the dead.
strings.타르타로스 쪽으로 갔어요. 타르타로스에 악마들이 잔뜩 있는 공간이 있다고: Toward Tartaros. I hear there's a place full of demons there. Could he have gone to it?
strings.아마도 그런 것 같아요. 그곳의 주인 샤이닉이 악마들과 몬스터들을 가둬놓: Probably. Shynic keeps demons and monsters imprisoned there. The Abyss Chamber...
strings.(지하도시 공사장에 가서 루인이 울을 봤나 물어봐야겠군. 그럼 어서 가볼: (I'll ask Ruin at the Underground City Construction Site if he's seen Ull. Better hurry.)
strings.공사장엔 무슨 일이야? 또 나락의 방에 가야 하는 일이라도 있어?: What brings you to the construction site? Need the Abyss Chamber again?
Well... Someone asked me to find a person.
strings.누굴 찾는지 모르겠는데, 그 사람이 나락의 방이라도 들어간 거야?: I don't know whom you're after, but did they enter the Abyss Chamber?
strings.혹시 찾는 사람이 꼬맹이야? 엄청나게 건방져 보이는?: A little brat? Looks incredibly full of himself?
strings.그래, 맞아. 그 꼬맹이 놈, 지하도시 공사장을 한 바퀴 돌고 만족스럽지: Yes, that's him. He did a lap of the construction site and looked thoroughly unsatisfied.
strings.울? 그 꼬맹이 이름이 울이야? 울이라면 은검룡 울? 검신 지스카드 양반: Ull? That's his name? Silver Sword Dragon Ull? Ziskad's youngest disciple?
First time I've seen a disciple of that famous Sword Master. Haha.
strings.뭐랄까, 그 표정 예전 란다인을 보고 있는 느낌이 들어서 불안하네. 누군: His expression reminded me of Randine back then. It worries me. Whoever asked you must be worried about him, too.
You know how to use your strength when it matters.
I still don't know how I should use it.
strings.겸손도 지나치면 독이 되는 거야. 그럴 땐 뻐기면서 잘난 척도 하는 거라: Too much humility can be poison. Sometimes you've got to puff up your chest and brag.
strings.꼬맹이가 나락의 방으로 들어간 지는 얼마 안 됐으니까 서둘러 가봐. 빨리: He entered the Abyss Chamber recently. Hurry, and you might catch him halfway through.
strings.(울이 어디쯤에서 수련하고 있을지 빨리 찾아보자….): (I'd better find where Ull is training...)
strings.여기 있었군. 사람이 왔는데, 아는 척도 안 하는 거야?: There you are. Won't even acknowledge a visitor?
strings.무슨 생각을 그렇게 해?: What are you thinking about so hard?
Nothing. How much more training I need.
Yuran sent you with her pointless worries again, I suppose.
strings.잘 알고 있네. 이쯤 되면 일부러 그러는 거 아냐?: You know perfectly well. Are you doing this on purpose?
strings.이 이야긴 더 하고 싶지 않아. 어차피 결론은 나지 않으니까. 그보다 너: I don't want to discuss it. It never leads anywhere. More to the point, you...
Your power feels stranger each time. Perhaps you're...
What? Why all of a sudden...?
strings.(울이 검을 거두고 피식 웃는다.): (Ull lowers his sword and gives a faint laugh.)
strings.미안, 내 착각이다. 나락의 방이 워낙 더러운 기운이 가득해서 잠깐 이상: Sorry. My mistake. This chamber is full of foul energy. I must have sensed it wrong for a moment.
I thought you wanted to spar.
strings.우습군. 네가 내 상대로 어울릴 거로 생각하는 거야?: Amusing. You think you'd make a suitable opponent for me?
strings.(울이 가볍게 미소를 짓자 주위에 엄청난 기운이 폭발했다 사라진다.): (As Ull smiles faintly, a tremendous force erupts around him, then vanishes.)
I'll accept you as an official sparring partner soon. Train hard until then.
strings.내가 해보고 싶어서 그래. 정식으로 요청하지. 이곳의 수다쟁이 까마귀도: I want to try. Consider it a formal request. You defeated that talkative crow here, didn't you? I'm interested.
I did, but at the time...
Never mind. We'll discuss it later. I'm going back to training. Get lost.
strings.사저한테는 아무 걱정하지 말라고 전해줘. 일반적인 수련이니까 정말로 아무: Tell her not to worry. It's ordinary training. Nothing will happen.
If you insist, I'll head back.
strings.(울은 %s의 모습이 사라져도 계속해서 검을 휘두른다. 잠시 후, 어디선: (Ull keeps swinging his sword after %s disappears. A little later, unfamiliar presences make him stop.)
strings.(수상한 기운이군. 잠시 지켜볼까?): (Strange energy. Shall I watch for a moment?)
strings.(붉은 머리를 한 남녀가 천천히 어딘가를 갔다 돌아오는 것 같다. 하지만: (A red-haired man and woman seem to be returning from somewhere. Both are scowling, as though things went badly.)
How much longer must we walk? With a magic stone, we'd be there...
Mara, how many times have I told you? We have no choice if we want to avoid Shynic. I erased our tracks all this way, and now you say that?
strings.알았어, 그만 해. 그보다 악마가 끌고 오는 마계의 흔적 같은 게 필요해: Fine, stop it. But do we really need traces of the Demon Realm brought by demons? We've still got plenty of stones. Enough to handle something like Moss...
strings.(마라가 마석 주머니를 꺼내 들어보이자 반이 빼앗아 바닥에 던져버린다.): (Mara takes out a pouch of magic stones. Ban snatches it and throws it to the ground.)
strings.너는 이 마석으로 전부 가능하다고 믿고 있지만, 우리는 벌써 몇 번이나: You think these stones can do everything, but we've failed over and over. Think differently for once!
strings.이게 다 그 여신과 여신을 따르는 그 녀석 때문이야. 우리 계획에 사사건: It's all that goddess and her follower. Interfering in every plan... Next time, I'll kill that one for certain.
strings.분명 그 남자와 계약하면 대륙의 한 자리를 차지할 수 있다고 했잖아. 그: You said making a contract with that man would secure our place on the continent. What is this, then...?
strings.그건 이제 끝났어. 생각도 하지 마, 젠장. 뱀 같은 녹스 왕자 놈은 말: That's over. Forget it. Damn it. That snake Prince Nox won't listen... We've come this far. We can only see it through.
We have to make one last stand before Moss falls.
All right, brother. Let's go to Oneiro... But those stones...
Leave them. They're defective. We can't use them properly anyway.
strings.(반과 마라가 나락의 방 입구 쪽으로 사라지자 울이 천천히 어둠 속에서: (As Ban and Mara disappear toward the chamber's entrance, Ull slowly emerges from the darkness.)
strings.저 녀석들이 원흉이었나…. 그런데 이 마석은 아직도 마력이 남아있는 것: So they were behind it... But these stones still seem to have mana.
strings.타르타로스 안에 있는 '나락의 방'이요. 그래도 한 번 다녀온 길이라 울: The Abyss Chamber in Tartaros. I'd been before, so finding him wasn't difficult.
The Abyss Chamber, of all places...
strings.마계에서 나락의 방으로 흘러들어온 말파스 때문에 타르타로스가 시끄러운 적: Malphas came there from the Demon Realm and caused a commotion in Tartaros.
strings.많은 사람이 말파스를 쓰러뜨리고 샤이닉이 건 상금을 가져가려 했지만, 아: Many tried to defeat him for Shynic's bounty. None succeeded. Some lost their lives and had their souls taken.
strings.울 또한 말파스를 쓰러뜨리기 위해 도전했지만, 란다인이란 자에게 부상을: Ull also tried, but was injured by someone named Randine and had to rest.
strings.다시 한번 말파스를 쓰러뜨리려고 했지만, 이미 여행을 떠난 모험가님께서: He meant to challenge Malphas again, but you had already defeated him and continued your journey.
He doesn't show it, but he must be concerned about you, %s.
Someone who defeated an opponent he couldn't...
strings.저 때문에 울이 힘에 집착하는 것 같다고 말씀하시고 싶은 건가요? 저는: Are you saying he's obsessed with power because of me? I only did what I had to do.
I'm sorry if it sounded that way.
strings.울을 너무 어린 애 취급하시는 건 아닌가요? 울은 유란 님에게 일반적인: Aren't you treating him too much like a child? He said it's ordinary training and nothing will happen...
And please don't ask me to go searching for Ull again.
Is Iris's training going well? I haven't had a chance to see her true self...
Oh, nothing. She's concentrating on training. I shouldn't disturb her... I'll return to Tartaros.
Then may your journey be uneventful.
strings.(%s의 모습이 루맨 저 멀리 사라질 때쯤, 이리스가 천천히 유란 앞으로: (As %s disappears into the distance beyond Lumen, Iris slowly approaches Yuran.)
Training finished early today. Bilbradha said he'd had enough, too...
strings.시간을 지켜주세요. 이리스 님께서도 말씀하셨다시피 %s 님께 영향이 갈: Please keep to the schedule. As you said yourself, Lady Iris, it could affect %s. The adventurer only just left.
Please don't use that person and Ull to test it.
strings.이용이 아닙니다. 그저 알고 싶었을 뿐입니다…. 만약에, 만약에 말입니다: I wasn't using them. I merely wanted to know... If, just if...
If something has gone wrong, Jin and I will cut the adventurer down ourselves.
strings.그럴 일은 결코 없을 거예요. 그분은 절대 그렇게 되지 않을테니까요. 제: That will never happen. That person will never become that. Because I do not wish it.
Understood. None of us wants the worst...
